rationale: Build-graph placement only. core/view/CMakeLists.txt gains platform/mac/accessibility_provider_mac_stub.cpp, a new stub that supplies the accessibility provider symbol the Apple SDK CLI link needs, and inspect/CMakeLists.txt moves src/main_thread_rpc.cpp into pulp-inspect-protocol, the archive whose session.cpp is its only caller, removing it from pulp-inspect-runtime so the symbol is defined exactly once. The family is triggered by the core/view/** selector rather than by any render behaviour: no renderer, backend, asset, shader, surface, or design-import path is touched, no header or public API changes, and no rendering output can differ. Pulp-only because the Apple static-archive scan order this repairs is a property of how Pulp links its own CLI, with no counterpart Vellum commit to backport.
